name: Market scan
description: Trends, demand signals, objections, and opportunity whitespace.
instruction: Focus on market-level trends, repeated needs, urgency, buyer language, objections, whitespace, and recommended next moves.

name: Account intelligence
description: Named accounts, authors, pain points, timing, and outreach angles.
instruction: Focus on account and author-level intelligence, buying triggers, pain points, timing clues, likely stakeholders, and useful outreach angles.

name: Subreddit pulse
description: Community sentiment, recurring threads, vocabulary, and complaints.
instruction: Focus on community sentiment, recurring questions, recurring complaints, native vocabulary, controversial arguments, and useful post ideas.

name: Lead list
description: Potential leads, qualification notes, evidence, and suggested follow-up.
instruction: Focus on extractable leads, qualifying context, evidence IDs, suggested follow-up, and reasons each lead appears relevant.

name: Competitive report
description: Competitor claims, positioning gaps, sentiment, and content angles.
instruction: Focus on competitor mentions, positioning claims, sentiment, gaps, risks, counter-positioning, and content or sales angles.
